# Crawling is allowed on purpose: every page carries <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">
# (generated by scripts/build.mjs). Search engines must be able to read a page to see that tag –
# a "Disallow" here would hide it and a shared link could still end up in search results.
# Repository files (README.md, scripts/, tests/ …) are not published at all (scripts/site.mjs).
User-agent: *
Disallow:
